simple.meaning: עִשָּׂרוֹן (ʻissârôwn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “(fractional) a tenth part.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 33 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Exodus 29:40. Its contexts include offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִשָּׂרוֹן (H6241).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עִשָּׂרוֹן (ʻissârôwn) / H6241 is traced through Exodus 29:40, Leviticus 14:10, Leviticus 14:21, Leviticus 23:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6241. issaron עִשָּׂרוֺן 33 noun masculine Lev 14:10 tenth part (of ephah; compare ᵐ5 δέκατον τοῦ οἰφί Num 15:4 , and הָאֵיפָה עֲשִׂירִית 28:5 ; i.e = עֹמֶר , see further Benz Archaeology 182 Now Archaeology i. 203 ); — abs; — ׳ע Lev 14:21 +, עִשָּׂרֹן Exod 29:40 ; Num 28:13 ; plural עֶשְׂרֹנִים 28:9 +; — only P (H), as measure of סֹלֶת used in meal-offering Exod 29:40 ; Lev 14:10 3 t. Leviticus (H only 23:17 ); Num 15:4 26 t. Numbers, including distributive עִשָּׂרוֺן ן (וֺ) עִשָּׂר 28:13 4 t.

occurrences.englishText: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah* 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin† A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons, so a fourth of a hin is about 1.6 liters. of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

“On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah* 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log† a log is a liquid measure of about 300 ml or 10 ounces of oil.

“If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah‡ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log§ a log is a liquid measure of about 300 ml or 10 ounces of oil;

The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah* 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.† A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah‡ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.
“You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah* 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel shall be in one cake.

then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah* 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin† A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. of oil.
“ ‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah‡ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah§ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
